title: Endless Overhaul
description: Endless Overhaul is an extremely heavy exploration-focused modpack that transforms every structure, biome, and dimension into a massively expanded world packed with dungeons, ruins, and more.
body:
⚠️ **WARNING**
===============================================

**Endless Overhaul** contains extremely heavy world generation, structure overhauls, biome expansions, decoration mods, and visual enhancements.  
Expect **longer load times**, **high RAM usage**, and **significant CPU/GPU load**, especially during world generation.

**Minimum RAM:** 6GB  
**Recommended RAM:** 8–10GB  
**Recommended GPU:** GTX 1060 or better  
**Expect boot times of several minutes**

---

🌌 **Endless Overhaul**
=======================

 _A massive Fabric modpack that transforms the entire Minecraft world._

**Endless Overhaul** takes vanilla Minecraft and expands it in every direction—without breaking its identity.  
You’ll find richer worlds, deeper exploration, better progression, and far more reasons to wander, build, and survive.

---

✨ **Core Features**
===================

🌍 **Complete World Generation Overhaul**
-----------------------------------------
* Better terrain and improved landscapes  
* Massive cave overhauls and unique underground regions  
* A fully expanded End dimension  
* Natural rivers, cliffs, valleys, and vistas  

Every world feels handcrafted.

---

🏰 **Tons of New Structures & Dungeons**
----------------------------------------
* Reimagined temples, strongholds, fortresses, and monuments  
* New dungeons, ruins, camps, and underground lairs  
* Expanded villages with unique layouts  
* Towers, hideouts, and world POIs everywhere you explore  

Exploring is now the core of Minecraft.

---

🧭 **More Wildlife & Atmosphere**
---------------------------------
* New creatures and ambient wildlife  
* Visual improvements to skies, fog, and weather  
* Environmental storytelling through ruins and scenery  

The world feels alive and immersive.

---

🍲 **Expanded Cooking & Farming**
-------------------------------------------
* New crops and farmable ingredients  
* Deep cooking and meal systems  
* Drinks, ingredients, and kitchen tools  
* Food-related decorations and appliances  

Survival is richer and more rewarding.

---

⚙️ **Automation & Engineering**
-------------------------------------------
* Mechanical-style automation  
* Improved rails and trains  
* Item processing and organization tools  
* Farming and production utilities  

A perfect balance between exploration and engineering.

---

🏡 **Building & Decoration**
----------------------------------------------
* Hundreds of new blocks and decorative variants  
* Furniture, lighting, roofs, windows, and structural sets  
* Tons of themed block palettes  

Perfect for cozy bases or huge megabuilds.

---

🧪 **Vanilla-Friendly Design**
------------------------------
* No overwhelming tech mods  
* No grindy magic  
* No broken power creep  
* Enhances Minecraft without replacing it  

A true vanilla++ experience.

---

📦 **Installation & Hardware Notes**
====================================
* Install via **Modrinth App** or Prism Launcher  
* Allocate **6GB minimum**, **8–10GB recommended**  
* First boot may take **3–6 minutes**  
* Best on **mid–high-end PCs**
